backend/main.mo: Main actor for a Hindu devotional app on ICP, defining data types (Katha, Aarti, Temple, CommunityPost, etc.) and state maps, with admin/authorization mixins and blob storage support.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that defines old and new data type shapes and converts legacy state (e.g., mapping pending community post status to approved) during canister upgrades.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (admin Katha publishing, TTS on Katha detail, instant community post visibility, performance optimizations) to their relevant source files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated JSON summary document describing the purpose and key details of each frontend source file in the project.
frontend/.env.example: Example environment file documenting the optional Google Gemini API key configuration, noting it is stored client-side and image generation uses Pollinations.ai.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS base styles defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, including background, foreground, card, border, and chart color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point that mounts the React app into a root div and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all app routes, wraps the app in QueryClientProvider and ThemeProvider, and renders the Toaster notification component.
frontend/src/components/AartiCard.tsx: A card component for displaying an aarti entry with its name, Hindi text preview, and optional deity tag, navigating to the aarti detail page on click.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: The main app layout wrapper that renders a sticky header with navigation links, a notification banner, the main content area, and a bottom navigation bar.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: A fixed bottom navigation bar rendering links to all major app sections with active-state highlighting and animations.
frontend/src/components/ChatMessage.tsx: Renders a single chat message bubble for user or AI assistant roles, with text-to-speech controls (play, pause, stop) for assistant messages using the speech narration hook.
frontend/src/components/ChatTypingIndica: Displays an animated three-dot typing indicator with an AI avatar, shown while the AI assistant is generating a response.
frontend/src/components/CommunityPostCar: Renders a community post card supporting text, image, video, and file attachments, with a like button and relative timestamp display in Hindi.
frontend/src/components/DailyDharmaQuote: Displays a daily dharma quote in Hindi and English with decorative styling, falling back to a hardcoded Bhagavad Gita quote if the API data is unavailable.
frontend/src/components/EkadashiReminder: Shows a dismissible banner reminding users of upcoming Ekadashi dates within the next 7 days, with session-based dismissal persistence.
frontend/src/components/FestivalCountdow: Displays a festival countdown card showing days remaining until a festival, with a share button that uses the Web Share API or clipboard fallback.
frontend/src/components/FloatingLotus.ts: Renders animated floating lotus petal images as a fixed background decoration using CSS keyframe animations.
frontend/src/components/GoldenHalo.tsx: Wraps children in a golden radial-gradient halo glow effect with a pulsing animation, supporting sm/md/lg or numeric size props.
frontend/src/components/KathaCard.tsx: Displays a clickable card for a Hindu katha (story) showing deity emoji, title, excerpt, and category badge, navigating to the katha detail page on click.
frontend/src/components/Loader.tsx: Shows a spinning mandala image with an Om symbol overlay and optional text as a loading indicator, supporting sm/md/lg sizes.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Renders a login/logout button using Internet Identity authentication, clearing the React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/LotusBloomOverla: Displays a full-screen animated lotus bloom overlay with petal burst particles when a 108-bead mala is completed, triggered by a numeric prop.
frontend/src/components/MalaRing.tsx: Renders an animated canvas-based mala (prayer bead ring) with 108 beads, showing filled beads based on count and a breathing Om symbol in the center.
frontend/src/components/NotificationBann: Shows a styled in-app notification banner with a type-specific icon and color scheme, auto-dismissing after 10 seconds via a progress bar.
Renders a brief particle burst animation of Om symbols radiating outward, auto-hiding after 700ms.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog component that prompts new users to enter their name to set up their profile, using a hardcoded admin token and defaulting to the 'omNamahShivaya' mantra.
frontend/src/components/SacredRipple.tsx: Renders animated concentric ripple rings centered on screen when triggered, keeping up to 4 simultaneous ripples that expand and fade out over 800ms.
frontend/src/components/ShlokaCard.tsx: Displays a Sanskrit shloka with its Hindi and English meanings in a decorative card, with copy-to-clipboard and native share functionality.
frontend/src/components/VratModeDashboar: A dashboard component showing fasting (vrat) related information including Brahma Muhurat timing and countdown timers to upcoming Ekadashi and Shivratri dates.
frontend/src/components/VratModeToggle.t: A toggle switch UI component that enables or disables 'Vrat Mode', visually changing its styling between active and inactive states using amber/saffron colors.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAIChat.ts: A custom hook managing AI chat state including message history (persisted to localStorage), sending messages via an AI engine, and handling loading, error, and retry states.
frontend/src/hooks/useDailyNotifications: React hook that schedules 7 daily browser notifications (or in-app banner fallbacks) at preset hours for Nam Jap, Aarti, and Vrat reminders, with enable/disable state persisted to localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Computer Internet Identity authentication, managing AuthClient creation, login/logout flow, and identity persistence with status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks (useQuery/useMutation) wrapping all backend actor calls for user profiles, admin checks, dharma quotes, kathas, community posts, bhajans, vrats, and other app data.
frontend/src/hooks/useSpeechNarration.ts: React hook that wraps the Web Speech API to provide text-to-speech narration with play/pause/stop controls, automatically selecting the best available voice for Hindi (Devanagari) or English content.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts, configures Tailwind CSS with a devotional saffron/gold OKLCH color theme (light and dark modes), and defines custom animations like float, glow-pulse, and flame-flicker.
frontend/src/lib/aiEngine.ts: Implements an AI response engine using Pollinations.ai free APIs, with a 'Divya Guru' Hindu spiritual guide system prompt and multiple fallback strategies (POST, GET, and Mistral model) for generating responses.
frontend/src/lib/aiGuruData.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and static data for a Hindu astrology/horoscope feature, including all 12 rashis (zodiac signs) with metadata and templated daily prediction content for love and career aspects.
frontend/src/lib/kathaData.ts: Contains static Hindi-language katha (religious story) data including full texts of Ramayan and Mahabharat, typed to match the backend Katha schema without the 'status' field.
frontend/src/lib/panchangEngine.ts: Implements a client-side Hindu Panchang (almanac) calculator using Jean Meeus astronomical algorithms to compute sun/moon longitudes, Julian Day numbers, and related calendar data for central India.
frontend/src/lib/staticData.ts: Provides static data for Hindu devotional content including Sanskrit shlokas with translations and full aarti texts (Ganesh, Shiv, Vishnu) in both Hindi and English.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React application entry point that mounts the app with React Query and Internet Identity authentication providers wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/Aarti.tsx: List page that displays all aartis from static data as navigable cards with emoji icons and preview text, linking to individual aarti detail pages.
frontend/src/pages/AartiDetail.tsx: Detail page for a single aarti that supports Hindi/English toggle, text-to-speech narration, copy, and share functionality, with a styled header and fallback for missing aartis.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin panel page with authentication checks, admin claim via token, and tabbed management of community posts, vrats, dharma quotes, and kathas using React Query hooks.
frontend/src/pages/AIGuru.tsx: Chat interface page for an AI spiritual guide ('Divya Guru') that displays messages, suggested Hindi prompts, a typing indicator, and allows clearing chat history using the useAIChat hook.
frontend/src/pages/Bhajans.tsx: Page displaying a list of static Hindi bhajans as expandable cards with per-bhajan text-to-speech playback support via the useSpeechNarration hook.
frontend/src/pages/Chalisa.tsx: Page displaying the full Hanuman Chalisa text with copy, share, and text-to-speech controls, along with a hero image header.
frontend/src/pages/Community.tsx: Community page that displays approved community posts and allows authenticated users to create new posts with optional image, video, or file attachments and deity tags.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Simple dashboard page that fetches and displays the logged-in user's profile with a welcome message and navigation hints.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page showing a hero banner, daily Panchang strip, category navigation grid, a daily dharma quote, and optional vrat mode/Ekadashi reminder banners.
frontend/src/pages/Jap.tsx: Mantra jap (chanting) counter page featuring a mala ring UI, mantra selector, progress tracking, and backend sync for daily/lifetime/streak stats.
frontend/src/pages/KathaDetail.tsx: Detail view for a single katha (story), fetching from backend or falling back to static data, with Hindi/English toggle and text-to-speech narration controls.
frontend/src/pages/Kathayen.tsx: Kathayen listing page that merges backend and static katha data, with search and category filter tabs, rendering each katha as a card.
frontend/src/pages/Mandir.tsx: Displays a temple finder page with a GPS-based Google Maps link to nearby Hindu temples and a list of well-known temples, featuring a golden ripple animation on a sacred portal link click.
frontend/src/pages/Mantras.tsx: Renders a list of Hindu mantras as expandable cards with Sanskrit, Hindi, and English text, supporting text-to-speech narration via a custom hook.
frontend/src/pages/Panchang.tsx: Shows a navigable Hindu Panchang (almanac) for a selected date, displaying tithi, nakshatra, vara, yoga, karana, paksha, sunrise/sunset, and auspicious muhurta periods.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: Displays the user's devotional profile including lifetime and daily jap stats, mala count, vrat mode toggle, and admin badge, pulling data from backend queries and Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/pages/VratDashboard.tsx: Provides a vrat (fasting) dashboard with live countdown timers to upcoming Hindu festival dates, a sattvic food guide, and a daily vrat checklist.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with helpers to persist, retrieve, and clear those parameters via sessionStorage and history.replaceState.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining a devotional color palette (saffron, gold, maroon, cream, warmYellow) and semantic design tokens mapped to CSS variables using the oklch color space.
project_state.json: Project state file for 'Divya Darshan' describing a religious app with Katha, Community, and Admin sections, tracking four existing features (instant katha publishing, auto TTS, instant community photo uploads, performance improvements) and their corresponding pending action requests.
